verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Windows ships some built-in utilities out of the box: Paint with Cocreator, the PC Health Check app, Live Captions, Game Bar and a widgets sidebar. None of the specific utilities named in the story (calendar, weather, maps, clock) appear in the pack, so this barely counts as support. Missing for 10: any evidence of built-in calendar, weather, maps or clock apps, any documentation of the default bundled app set, and hands-on corroboration from switchers.
